name: app-black-pill-tab-bar-with-active-label-states-on-white-card
title: Black Pill Tab Bar Active Label States
whatItIs: A white rounded card on light grey holding five black pill bars, each with five outline icons where a different one is active as a dark grey pill with filled icon and label (Home, Category, Cart, Save, Profile).
whatItMeans: Stacking the five states shows the whole set at once, and white outline icons on black are crisp and legible.
techniques: Active tab as a dark grey pill with a label
Outline icons for inactive and filled for active
Five states stacked in one card
Black bars on a white card

vocabulary.definition: A text label shown only on the selected tab.
An icon drawn with a thin stroke.
Vertically listed versions showing each state.
